about_short_description.short_description: BRINC Drones develops technology that enhances public safety, focusing on hardware, software, and services for emergency responders.

product.name: BRINC Guardian
product.description: Large outdoor emergency-response drone designed for continuous public-safety operations, including automated dispatch, long-range surveillance, thermal imaging, communications, and delivery of emergency payloads.

product.name: BRINC Responder
product.description: A purpose-built 911 response drone for on-demand public-safety awareness, with 4G teleoperations, visual and thermal cameras, two-way communications, obstacle avoidance, and emergency payload delivery.

product.name: BRINC LiveOps
product.description: A browser-based drone operations platform for teleoperation, dispatch, live streaming, communications, fleet management, mapping, integrations, and CJIS-oriented evidence storage.

product.name: BRINC Guardian Station
product.description: An automated outdoor drone station that launches, lands, recharges, and supports Guardian operations for continuous public-safety response across broad service areas.

product.name: BRINC Lemur 2
product.description: An indoor tactical drone for scouting hazardous or inaccessible environments, with 4K, night-vision, and thermal imaging, two-way communications, LiDAR mapping, and a glass-breaker attachment.

product.name: BRINC Responder Station
product.description: A compact charging and deployment station for Responder drones that supports rapid launch, autonomous return, recharging, weather protection, and integration with public-safety dispatch and operations systems.
